user.title: Connect the Bond Bridge
user.description: The fan is controlled by radio through a Bond Bridge. The official Bond integration is not needed.

data_description.host: Give the bridge a fixed address in your router, or the fan stops working when the address changes.
data_description.access_token: Bond app > bridge > Advanced Settings > Local Token. Leave empty for a bridge that is already set up here. Otherwise an empty field makes the integration ask the bridge, which only answers within 10 minutes of being powered on.

method.title: Register the remote
method.description: The integration needs the id of your remote. It can read the id from the remote, which is the recommended way.

learn.title: Learn the remote (1 of 2)
learn.description:
Hold the remote about 30 cm from the Bond Bridge. Continue to the next screen, then press the **fan off** button (회전종료) on the remote **once**. You have about 30 seconds.

The fan receives the press too. If the fan is off, the fan off button changes nothing.

data_description.frequency_khz: Change this only if no signal is found at the default of 447885 kHz.

learn_again.title: Learn the remote (2 of 2)
learn_again.description:
The first signal was received. Continue to the next screen, then press the same button **once more**.

The two signals are compared to check that this remote works the way the integration expects.

finish.title: Remote recognized
finish.description:
Remote id `{remote_id}`, checksum constant {constant}.

Keep the remote id to yourself: anyone within radio range who knows it can control the fan.

manual.title: Enter the remote values
manual.description: Use this if you already know the id and checksum constant of your remote.

data_description.checksum_constant: 8 on the remote this integration was developed with.

reconfigure.title: Bond Bridge connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when the address or the token of the bridge has changed.

data_description.access_token: Leave empty to keep the current token.

progress.capture: The Bond Bridge is listening. Press the button on the remote once, now.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Bond Bridge. Check the address.
error.not_bond: The device at this address does not answer like a Bond Bridge.
error.token_locked: The token could not be fetched. Enter the local token from the Bond app, or power the bridge off and on and try again within 10 minutes.
error.no_signal: No signal was received. Hold the remote about 30 cm from the Bond Bridge and try again.
error.no_frame: A signal was received but could not be read. Press the button once, briefly, and try a slightly different distance.
error.capture_failed: The scan failed. See the log for details.
error.id_mismatch: The two signals came from different remotes. Another remote may have been picked up. Start again.
error.same_counter: The two signals carry the same counter. Press the button exactly once each time and start again.
error.invalid_remote_id: The remote id is 5 hex digits or 20 binary digits.

abort.already_configured: This remote is already set up.

data_description.frequency_khz: 447885 kHz worked on the fan this integration was developed with.
data_description.repeats: The remote sends each frame 7 times per press.

auth_failed.message: The Bond Bridge refused the token. Reconfigure the integration.

transmit_failed.message: Could not transmit through the Bond Bridge: {error}
